# CDL Entry Level Driver Training (ELDT): School Bus (S) Endorsement

> 5-hour online entry-level driver training theory for the CDL School Bus (S) endorsement under the FMCSA ELDT requirements (49 CFR Part 380). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com), listed on the FMCSA Training Provider Registry.

## Key facts
- Duration: 5 hours; 4 modules, 11 lessons, final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 0.5 CEU
- Price: $79.99 per person; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, mobile-friendly, audio playback
- Reporting: completion sent to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry
- Required since February 2022 before taking the S endorsement knowledge test
- Prerequisite: valid Class B or C commercial learner's permit (CLP) or CDL, depending on the school bus
- Also required: medical exam by an examiner on FMCSA's National Registry; background check and fingerprinting; state school bus knowledge test; skills tests in the type of school bus to be driven
- Behind-the-wheel training: not included
- State acceptance: every state except Washington

## Modules
1. Operational Considerations (vehicle orientation; pre-trip and post-trip inspections; danger zones and use of mirrors; railroad-highway grade crossings)
2. Student Management (loading and unloading procedures; student management)
3. Emergency and Safety Procedures (post-crash procedures; emergency exit and evacuation)
4. Security and Inspections (special safety considerations; school bus security; route and stop reviews)

## Who should take it
New school bus drivers; CDL holders adding the S endorsement for the first time; school district staff such as substitute drivers; private or charter bus company drivers providing school transportation; state and local government employees who drive school buses.
